report.summary: 4 findings: 2 confirmed, 1 narrowed, 1 needs-evidence. Plan addresses race condition in killswitch, missing check logic in checks.py, foreign key validation in embeddings.py, and type-node assumptions in forest.py.
risks: Race condition fix may introduce new timing issues; requires careful review.
Adding foreign key constraint may break existing data; migration needed.
Check logic implementation may conflict with existing deepseek provider code.
Type node filtering may affect token budgets and routing decisions.
Dependency: gate 0 kernel must be stable before modifying core modules.
todos: Fix race condition in killswitch._watch_loop to prevent fabricated 'gates_failed' verdicts.
Implement missing check logic in checks.py using CheckPolicy fields.
Add foreign key constraint and validation in embeddings.py for record_journal_watermark.
Audit and fix type node filtering in dss._estimated_tokens and graph.fenced_dominance.

items.title: Fix race condition in killswitch._watch_loop to prevent fabricated 'gates_failed' verdicts
items.why_now: Critical bug: cancelled candidates can be recorded as 'gates_failed', polluting evaluation metrics and picker scoring. Blocks reliable candidate evaluation.

steps.do: Modify _watch_loop in daedalus/spine/killswitch.py to set a cancellation flag before terminating the process, and check that flag in the gate callback to record 'cancelled' instead of 'gates_failed'.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'cancelled' daedalus/spine/killswitch.py && run test that simulates race: test_killswitch.py::test_cancellation_records_cancelled_not_gates_failed

steps.do: Update daedalus/spine/attempt.py to check cancellation flag in _gate method before recording verdict.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'cancelled' daedalus/spine/attempt.py && run existing tests in test_spine_attempt.py

items.assumption: The race condition is reproducible; the fix will not introduce deadlocks.

items.title: Implement missing check logic in daedalus/lanes/checks.py using CheckPolicy fields
items.why_now: The scanned chunk defines CheckPolicy fields but no checks use them; write lanes may accept invalid content. Blocks end-to-end vertical slice.

steps.do: Implement no_elision, not_truncated, toplevel_defs, and other checks using elision_markers, min_size_ratio, min_symbol_survival from CheckPolicy.
Add tests for each check to verify correct refusal/pass behavior.

items.assumption: The check logic is not already implemented in another part of the file or in deepseek.py; full file review needed.

items.title: Add foreign key constraint and validation in daedalus/memory/embeddings.py for record_journal_watermark
items.why_now: Orphaned watermark rows possible if spec.index_id does not exist in embeddings table. Medium severity; blocks data integrity.

steps.do: Add foreign key constraint on journal_position.index_id referencing embeddings(index_id) in SQLite schema.
Add validation in record_journal_watermark to check index_id exists before inserting.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'def record_journal_watermark' daedalus/memory/embeddings.py && check for validation logic

items.assumption: The database schema can be altered without breaking existing data; migration needed.

items.title: Audit and fix type node filtering in dss._estimated_tokens and graph.fenced_dominance
items.why_now: If type nodes are included in token budgets or safety fence calculations, routing decisions may be incorrect. High severity if violated.

steps.do: Inspect dss._estimated_tokens to verify type nodes are excluded; add filter if missing.
Inspect graph.fenced_dominance to verify type nodes are excluded; add filter if missing.
Add documentation in forest.py about type node exclusion contract.

items.assumption: The assumption that type nodes are excluded may be already implemented; audit needed to confirm.
